name: MMSIBench
intro: MMSI-Bench 是多图空间智能基准。六名 3D 视觉研究者从八个真实世界数据集、超过 12 万张候选图像中人工构建 1,000 道四选一问题，最终使用 1,990 张独立图像，并以详细推理、可信干扰项和三名独立审核者保证质量；论文评测 37 个 MLLM。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Zhejiang University, Tsinghua Universit
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
eval_feature: 多图像空间推理, 推理标注, 错误分析
scale: 1,000个问题, 1,990张最终图像, 12万余候选图像
eval_feature_en: Multi-image spatial reasoning, reasoning annotations, error analysis
intro_en: MMSI-Bench evaluates multi-image spatial intelligence. Six 3D-vision researchers manually built 1,000 four-choice questions from more than 120,000 candidate images across eight real-world datasets, yielding 1,990 unique final images. Detailed reasoning, plausible distractors, and three independent reviewers support quality; the paper evaluates 37 MLLMs.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23764 Sections 3-5. The diagram distinguishes the 120K+ candidate pool from 1,990 unique final images, names all eight real-world sources, preserves the ten-basic-plus-one-multistep taxonomy, six-researcher free-form annotation, exact four-choice and rationale contract, three independent reviewers, 37-model setup, exact-match plus VLMEvalKit fallback, and four automated error modes.
